verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a chat/community platform, since comparable products offer self-hosted deployments, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Discord can be self-hosted: the docs describe a hosted service used through a desktop download or the browser, with developers building bots, apps and SDK integrations against Discord's own API and Gateway. Running your own bot backend is not self-hosting the core product, so absence of evidence yields none.
